levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة الأنصاري

notes: two taḥwīl branches, each written with its own names, so two groups and a null tail; «عمي» before «يحيى» is one link (rule 7)
the dashed gloss «وما أدركت رجلا ...» is a comment, not a link; the Companion's saying ends at the Prophet
the second branch's chain continues after its shared «شعبة»; whether the first branch also runs on past شعبة is not written, so it is left at شعبة
